t: The free desktop software for programming Thymio robots with icons, blocks, or text.
steps: Find Thymio Suite on the thymio.org site.
Ask IT to install it on school computers.
Connect a Thymio by USB or with the wireless dongle.
Open VPL and build a first program.
Try Scratch or Blockly with older students.
Install Thymio Suite Mobile on tablets if needed.
Put the tablets on the same Wi-Fi as the computer.
